title: Notated Music / Printed Music Six quatuor a deux violons, taille e basse obligés, dedicated to Monsieur Patrick Alstrómer, conseiller du commerce de Sa Majesté le Roi de Suede by Jean Julien Hummel / composed by Luigi Boccherini; second opera Boccherini, Luigi (1743-1805) — [ca. 1780] See the work D
why_manual: BNE refuses scripted requests; only a browser can fetch it.
correction_note: The Alstromer-dedicated edition of Op. 8. RISM catalogues it with NO Gerard number and NO incipits at PL-WRu (61343 Muz., manuscript copy) and B-Bc (6430, manuscript copy); BNE holds the printed edition those copies derive from. Identified by hand from the BNE copy: the six quartets are G 165-170 but the first two are transposed in the print's order -- Quartetto I is G 166 and Quartetto II is G 165, thereafter sequential.
established_by: identified by hand from the scan, 2026-09-28
medium_established_by: Checked 2026-09-29 and left as print. RISM's linked records call it a Manuscript copy, but the title page is engraved: 'SIX QUATUOR a Deux Violons, Taille e Basse obligés, DEDIES A MONSIEUR PATRICK ALSTRÖMER ... A AMSTERDAM chez J. J. HUMMEL'. A Hummel engraved title page is not a manuscript. The RISM link is to the Alströmer records, which describe a different copy.

contents_verified.found: Engraved Hummel print, Op. 8 (opera seconda), dedicated to Patrick Alströmer. RISM calls the linked records manuscripts; they describe another copy.

rism_related_established_by: RISM 702003012 holds only at B-Bc and 301002449 only at PL-WRu; neither lists E-Mn, so neither describes this BNE copy. Same work elsewhere, not this copy. [claim.py, 2026-10-01]
